newsitem.title: UK: UK engineering turnover down 0.2% in Q3.
newsitem.headline: UK engineering turnover down 0.2% in Q3.

text.p: Total turnover of the UK engineering industries fell by 0.2 percent in the third quarter of 1996 compared with the previous quarter, the Office for National Statistics said on Thursday.
The drop was due to a 0.6 percent decline in export turnover which more than offset a 0.1 percent increase in home turnover.

Compared to the same period a year ago, total turnover increased by 1.7 percent. Total orders on hand at the end of September were 1.3 percent lower than at the end of June 1996 and were 5.5 percent down on September 1995.
